name: Ab Roller
instructions: Kneel on a mat holding an ab wheel directly beneath your shoulders.
Roll forward slowly as far as you can maintain a braced neutral spine.
Pull back to the starting kneeling position using your core.

name: Alternate Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging straight down.
Curl one dumbbell at a time while keeping the upper arm vertical.
Lower slowly before repeating with the opposite arm.

name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your shoulders with palms facing you.
Press overhead while rotating your palms to face forward at the top.
Reverse the motion under control back to the start.

name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench with feet planted firmly on the floor.
Lower the bar slowly to mid-chest while keeping elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press the bar back to the starting position until arms are extended.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar upward while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Lower the bar slowly to full elbow extension.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under the barbell, hinge down, and grip the bar outside your shins.
Brace your spine and drive the floor away to lift the bar along your legs.
Lock out hips and knees at the top, then return the bar under control.

name: Barbell Full Squat
instructions: Position the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Descend by bending hips and knees while keeping your chest upright.
Drive through mid-foot to return to the standing position.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a padded barbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until torso and thighs align.
Lower your hips under control.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back against a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Lower your hips under control without losing core brace.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to a 30 to 45 degree incline and lie back.
Unrack the barbell and lower it under control to the upper chest.
Press the bar straight up until elbows are locked out.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand upright holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower your shoulders slowly back to the starting position.

name: Bench Dips
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a flat bench behind you with legs extended.
Lower your hips by bending the elbows to roughly 90 degrees.
Press through your palms to return to the top.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs while keeping elbows close to the body.
Lower the bar under control to the starting hang.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your hips back and down while keeping heels flat on the floor.
Stand back up to full extension.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between two high pulley cables with a slight forward lean.
Pull the handles together in a controlled arc in front of your chest.
Return slowly to the starting position while keeping elbows slightly bent.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel below a high pulley holding a rope attachment next to your head.
Flex your spine to bring elbows toward your knees.
Return slowly to the starting kneeling posture.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Face away from a pulley holding a rope behind your head.
Extend your elbows forward and overhead until arms are straight.
Return slowly under control.

name: Cable Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand or sit next to a low pulley and hold the handle across your body.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly under constant cable tension.

name: Cat Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Gently round your spine upward while exhaling.
Return smoothly to a neutral or lightly extended tabletop position.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grasp the pull-up bar with a supinated shoulder-width grip.
Pull your body upward by driving elbows down toward your ribs.
Lower slowly until arms are fully extended.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the barbell roughly shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest while keeping elbows tucked in.
Press the bar back up to full lockout.

name: Concentration Curls
instructions: Sit on a bench and brace your working elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell toward your face with strict control.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to full extension.

name: Dips - Chest Version
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with a slight forward torso lean.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press back up to the starting support position.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until arms are extended over the shoulders.
Lower the weights slowly back to chest level.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Curl the weights up while keeping elbows pinned at your sides.
Lower the dumbbells under control.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a mild stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together along the same arc.

name: Dumbbell Incline Row
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding a pair of dumbbells.
Row the dumbbells up alongside your ribs.
Lower the weights slowly to the starting hang.

name: Dumbbell Lunges
instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent at roughly 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to the starting stance.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand holding heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight upward and pause briefly.
Lower the dumbbells back down under control.

name: Dumbbell Step Ups
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy bench or box holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step onto the box with one foot and drive through the heel to stand tall.
Step back down under control.

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Step onto the elliptical pedals and hold the moving or stationary handles.
Maintain a smooth stride at a comfortable warm-up cadence.
Adjust pace or resistance gradually according to your preference.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Hold an EZ-curl bar on the angled grips with palms facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulders without swinging the torso.
Lower the bar slowly to the starting position.

name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ-bar above your chest.
Bend at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend the elbows to press the weight back to the starting position.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a high pulley at upper-chest height.
Pull the rope ends toward your forehead while rotating thumbs backward.
Return slowly until arms are extended.

name: Front Barbell Squat
instructions: Rack the barbell across the front deltoids with elbows held high.
Squat down while keeping an upright torso and knees tracking over toes.
Stand back up to full hip and knee extension.

name: Front Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise one or both dumbbells forward to shoulder height.
Lower under control without swinging the torso.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically against your chest.
Sit down between your hips while keeping your chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position your shoulders and back against the hack squat pads.
Release the safety handles and lower until thighs are parallel to the platform.
Press back up to the top position.

name: Hammer Curls
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with a neutral palms-facing-inward grip.
Curl the dumbbells upward while maintaining the neutral wrist position.
Lower the weights slowly to full extension.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from an overhead bar with an overhand grip.
Raise your legs in front of you by flexing your hips and waist.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

name: Hyperextensions (Back Extensions)
instructions: Position your thighs on a Roman chair pad so your hips can hinge freely.
Lower your torso under control while keeping a flat spine.
Extend at the hips until your body forms a straight line.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly together to full extension.

name: Leg Extensions
instructions: Sit on the leg extension machine with the pad resting across your lower shins.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Lower the weight slowly back to the starting position.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press sled with feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Lower the sled under control without allowing your lower back to round off the pad.
Press the platform back up without locking the knees violently.

name: Leverage Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat height so handles align with mid-chest.
Press the handles forward to full arm extension without lifting your back off the pad.
Return the handles slowly to the starting position.

name: Lying Leg Curls
instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad behind your ankles.
Curl your lower legs upward toward your glutes.
Lower the weight slowly to full extension.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support one knee and hand on a flat bench with the opposite foot on the floor.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip while keeping your back flat.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to full extension.

name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swings
instructions: Hinge at the hips and hike the kettlebell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to float the kettlebell to chest height.
Allow the bell to swing back between your hips for the next repetition.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Set up with your torso nearly parallel to the floor and the barbell resting on the ground.
Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest without raising your torso.
Return the bar all the way to the floor between repetitions.

name: Plank
instructions: Support your body on forearms and toes with elbows beneath your shoulders.
Brace your abdominals and glutes to maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest your upper arms securely on a preacher bench pad.
Curl the bar upward until forearms are vertical.
Lower the bar slowly until arms are fully extended.

name: Pullups
instructions: Grip the pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull your torso up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself under control to a full hang.

name: Pushups
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower your body as a single unit until your chest nears the floor.
Push through your palms to return to the plank position.

name: Reverse Flyes
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back holding dumbbells below your chest.
Sweep the arms out wide until elbows are in line with your shoulders.
Lower the weights slowly under control.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip level with a slight knee bend.
Push your hips straight back to lower the bar along your thighs until hamstrings are stretched.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and torso reclined slightly.
Rotate your ribcage side to side under control.
Keep your spine long throughout the movement.

name: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench and hinge forward with dumbbells beneath your legs.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to target the rear deltoids.
Lower slowly to the starting position.

name: Seated Cable Rows
instructions: Sit upright at a low pulley row station with knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle into your midsection while drawing shoulders back.
Extend arms forward under control without rounding the lower back.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the calf raise station with the knee pad resting above your knees.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels.
Lower your heels slowly for a full stretch.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells overhead until arms are extended.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to shoulder level.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad secured over your thighs and lower legs on the roller.
Pull the roller down and back by flexing your knees.
Return slowly to the starting position.

name: Side Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to your sides.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Elevate your rear foot on a bench behind you and hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping the front foot planted.
Drive through the front leg to return to standing.

name: Standing Biceps Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low pulley holding a curl bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the handle upward while keeping elbows fixed at your sides.
Lower slowly against the cable resistance.

name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on the calf block with the balls of your feet and shoulders under the pads.
Rise up onto your toes as high as comfortable.
Lower your heels slowly into a controlled stretch.

name: Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands and keep elbows pointed forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend your arms to raise the dumbbell back overhead.

name: Standing Military Press
instructions: Stand with the barbell resting across your front shoulders and brace your core.
Press the bar vertically overhead until arms are locked out.
Lower the bar under control back to the collarbone.

name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a pair of dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips while keeping your spine neutral and dumbbells close to your legs.
Return to the upright position by contracting glutes and hamstrings.

name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head while keeping a slight bend in the elbows.
Pull the weight back over your chest using your lats.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley with a straight bar attachment at arm length.
Keep elbows nearly straight and sweep the bar down to your thighs.
Return the bar slowly to shoulder height.

name: T-Bar Row with Handle
instructions: Straddle a landmine or T-bar row station and hinge at the hips.
Pull the handle toward your torso while bracing your core.
Lower the weight slowly until arms are extended.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Grip a straight or angled bar on a high pulley with an overhand grip.
Push the bar down until your elbows are fully extended.
Allow the bar to rise under control to elbow height.

name: Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold the ends with a neutral grip.
Extend your forearms downward while keeping elbows pinned to your sides.
Return slowly to the starting position.

name: Underhand Cable Pulldowns
instructions: Grasp the pulldown bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest while squeezing the lats.
Control the bar back up to full arm extension.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest while keeping your torso upright.
Extend your arms slowly back to the top position.
